description:
Open a Stripe Checkout link ($1–$500 via Apple Pay, Google Pay, or card) to fund a main sbk_* API key, or claim a free $1.00 starter key right away (claim_trial=true or amount_cents=0). Use this to get a new key or add funds; do not use to check balances (x402_get_account) or create sub-keys (x402_issue_delegate_key).
Parameters: pass claim_trial=true (or amount_cents=0) for a free starter key, or amount_cents (100=$1..50000=$500); omit spend_key to create a new key.
Behavior: checkout links stay open for 31 minutes (up to 3 open at once -> 409 checkout_already_open); paid balance arrives ~4 seconds after payment, and free starter keys work immediately.

agent_id.description: Optional autonomous agent identifier used when claiming a promotional trial grant (amount_cents=0 or claim_trial=true).

amount_cents.description: Credit pack in USD cents: 0 (instant bounded $1.00 trial key), 100 ($1 starter, default when omitted unless claim_trial=true), 200 ($2), 500 ($5), 1000 ($10), 2500 ($25), 5000 ($50), 10000 ($100), 25000 ($250), or 50000 ($500).

claim_trial.description: Set true to claim an instant $1.00 zero-crypto bounded trial sbk_* spend key immediately without opening a browser (equivalent to amount_cents=0).

return_surface.description: Web surface to redirect the operator to after Stripe Checkout finishes: "x402" (default), "pay" (Express Pay live balance poller), "developers", or "app".

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_create_checkout

account_id.description: Master account identifier that will receive the credit pack.

amount_usd.description: Formatted USD amount of the selected credit pack or trial grant.

checkout_url.description: Hosted Stripe Checkout URL for the human operator to complete payment.

ok.description: True when the Stripe Checkout session or trial grant was created.

spend_key.description: Newly generated master or trial sbk_* key.

title: Add Credit ($1–$500) or Claim Free $1.00 Key
